# Synthetic proposal: documented community water maintenance

Applicant: Example Community Services Association, a registered nonprofit.

Request: USD 25,000 for twelve months. The attached synthetic budget totals USD 25,000.

The project will train 20 named water committee members and repair 10 documented hand pumps. Baseline inspection records identify the 10 pumps. Signed committee letters confirm participation. Monthly maintenance logs and independent end-line inspections will measure pump functionality.
